name: Chandravarti Rasa

sections.introduction: Chandravarti Rasa is an Ayurvedic formulation. It is used to treat urinary tract infection, urinary calculi, cold, cough, dermatitis. It is also a natural aphrodisiac as well as an anti- aging medicine.
sections.dosage: 2 tablets twice a day after meals.
sections.indications:
Urinary calculi 
 Urinary tract infection 
 Abdominal colic pain 
 Cold 
 Cough 
 Rhinitis 
 Bronchitis 
 Asthma 
 Eczema 
 Dermatitis 
 Allergic skin conditions 
 Bloating
sections.contraindications:
Over dosage should be avoided as it causes burning sensation in abdomen. 
 Patients with blood pressure should take it under strict medical supervision. 
 Self-medication is not encouraged. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Chandravarti Rasa 
 Introduction 
 Chandravarti Rasa is an Ayurvedic formulation. It is used to treat urinary tract infection, urinary calculi, cold, cough, dermatitis. It is also a natural aphrodisiac as well as an anti- aging medicine. 
 Dosage 
 2 tablets twice a day after meals. 
 Indications 
 
 Urinary calculi 
 Urinary tract infection 
 Abdominal colic pain 
 Cold 
 Cough 
 Rhinitis 
 Bronchitis 
 Asthma 
 Eczema 
 Dermatitis 
 Allergic skin conditions 
 Bloating 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Over dosage should be avoided as it causes burning sensation in abdomen. 
 Patients with blood pressure should take it under strict medical supervision. 
 Self-medication is not encouraged. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
